market_brief: Nvidia's beat is supporting Asian chip names (Kospi ~+3%, SK Hynix +6%, SoftBank +7%) after a heavy Tuesday when the S&P 500 fell 1.2%, the Dow 1.8%, the Euro Stoxx 50 2.1% and the VIX rose 12% to ~25.7. The other force is rates: the dollar hit a 19-month high (DXY ~103.7) and a December Fed hike is fully priced before tonight's FOMC minutes, with the US 10Y at 5.10%, BTC near $64k (-13% w/w) and gold flat near $3,850. UK CPI came in at 3.6%, as expected, with core steady at 2.8%, while India gave back ~0.5% on profit-taking (Titan -4%) and USD/INR is at 93.5. Brent is hovering near $92.6 after an API build. Anthropic prices its IPO today, with reports that demand could take it above $80.
ai_brief: Anthropic's IPO pricing today is the AI sector's main event, with reported demand above the $70-78 range ahead of Thursday's Nasdaq debut. More detail on OpenAI's GPT-6.2 shows an Ultrafast tier at up to 4.5x token cost. Robotics funding keeps coming: Agile Robots raised $500M at $8.5B (SoftBank-led) and Genesis AI $500M at $3.5B. Malaysia is seeking details from Anthropic on an AI-run election-influence operation.

items.headline: UK October CPI rises to 3.6% y/y as fuel jumps; core steady at 2.8%
items.summary: Headline inflation edged up from 3.5%, in line with consensus, with monthly CPI +0.5%. Motor-fuel inflation hit 33.2%, its highest since mid-2022, while core held at 2.8% and services at 3.7%, keeping a December BoE hike debate open.

items.headline: Update on Asia after Nvidia: Kospi extends gains near +3%; SoftBank, Kioxia +7%
items.summary: Following the previous run's open, Kospi rose about 3% to ~5,116 with Samsung +4.9% and SK Hynix +6.2%. In Tokyo, SoftBank and Kioxia gained roughly 7% as the Nikkei opened about 1% higher.

items.headline: Sensex, Nifty give back gains; Titan -4%, Nifty dips below 25,250
items.summary: Indian equities fell ~0.5% by midday on profit-taking after a strong run, with Sensex near 82,120 and Nifty ~25,250; 14 of 16 sectors opened red. Titan led losers while Cipla and SBI gained; gold and silver ETFs slid on Fed-hike expectations.

items.headline: Dollar near 19-month high as markets price a December Fed hike before minutes
items.summary: DXY touched ~103.78, its highest since April 2025, after import prices rose 1.1% vs 0.7% expected; CME FedWatch shows a 25bp December hike priced. USD/JPY sits near 159.3 and AUD at its weakest since January; FOMC minutes are due at 19:00 GMT.

items.headline: Update: Anthropic prices IPO today; WSJ reports demand could push it above $80
items.summary: The 825M-share deal (range $70-78) prices Wednesday US time and trades Thursday as ANT; new reporting says the price may exceed $80, versus ~6-7x oversubscription cited earlier. Q3 revenue was reportedly $17B and possible MSCI/Nasdaq-100 inclusion dates are in focus.

items.headline: Nvidia details: data-centre revenue $107.6B, EPS $2.70; shares +~4-5% after hours
items.summary: Following the beat covered last run, further detail shows net income of $65.3B and diluted EPS of $2.70 versus $1.30 a year ago. Reports say Jensen Huang is open to returning, though no decision has been announced.

items.headline: FTSE 100 futures point ~0.4% lower after Tuesday's steepest drop in eight months
items.summary: London was set to open near 10,651 after a 1.8% fall on Tuesday; Nvidia's beat did little to lift European futures ahead of the UK CPI print and Fed minutes.

items.headline: Brent slips toward $92.6 on API build; Hormuz attacks limit downside
items.summary: Brent fell ~0.6% in Asia after API showed a 5.3M-barrel crude build; UKMTO has counted seven attacks near Hormuz since Nov 10. Brent is ~20% lower in November but still up more than 50% this year; EIA data and OPEC+ (Nov 29) are next.

items.headline: Hong Kong tech hit by US remote-access chip rule; Baidu at post-listing low
items.summary: Hang Seng opened 1% lower after the US moved to require licences for overseas data centres serving Chinese firms; GDS fell ~10.6% and Alibaba ~3.3%. Baidu dropped to a record low in Hong Kong after a sixth straight quarterly revenue decline.

items.headline: Baidu Q3: revenue -1% to RMB30.8B as AI Cloud nearly doubles and ads fall 22%
items.summary: AI Cloud revenue rose 94% to RMB8.2B while online marketing fell 22% to RMB11.9B. Baidu swung to RMB1.4B net income and expects to pay its first dividend before year-end, subject to board approval.

items.headline: Retail and security earnings today: Lowe's, Target, TJX pre-market; Palo Alto after close
items.summary: Consensus per Newsquawk: Lowe's EPS $2.89 on $22.4B revenue, Target $2.07 on $26.5B, TJX $1.34 on $15.8B, and Palo Alto $0.97 on $3.31B. Readings on the US consumer follow Home Depot's mixed print.

items.headline: Bitcoin steadies near $64.5k with sentiment at 'extreme fear'
items.summary: BTC traded around $64.4-64.9k and ETH near $1,800 after a ~13% weekly drop; the crypto Fear & Greed index read 11. Hike odds of ~98% for December remain the main headwind, per the report.

items.headline: Crypto-desk chatter: Nvidia reportedly paused licensed Hopper shipments to China
items.summary: A KuCoin market note says Nvidia halted licensed Hopper deliveries to China, which it puts at $2.4B of Q3 sales; this is unconfirmed and attributed. The same note cites a $2.5T cloud backlog figure.

items.headline: India IPO/flows: Crystal Crop IPO 0.5x on day one; SpiceJet +5% before fundraise meeting
items.summary: Crystal Crop Protection's issue drew 0.5x subscription by midday, led by retail at 0.72x. SpiceJet rose ~4.9% ahead of a board meeting on raising funds.

items.headline: Malaysia's regulator seeks details from Anthropic on an AI-run influence campaign
items.summary: MCMC asked Anthropic for more information on a Claude account it removed that ran a platform targeting Malaysian voters with ~1,000 fake X accounts. Malaysia is weighing legal action and drafting an AI bill.

items.headline: Next 36h: EIA stocks, FOMC minutes (19:00 GMT), Anthropic pricing, PANW (Wed); ANT debut, GTA VI (Thu)
items.summary: Wednesday brings EIA crude data at 10:30 ET, October FOMC minutes and after-hours Palo Alto results, with Anthropic's final price overnight. Thursday features ANT's Nasdaq debut; OPEC+ meets Nov 29.

items.headline: GPT-6.2 detail: new 'Ultrafast' mode costs up to 4.5x standard token rate
items.summary: Following yesterday's launch, 9to5Mac reports Ultrafast is available with Sol on the $200 Pro plan and on both models at $500. Per OpenAI, Sol came within half a point of Astra on FrontierCode 2.0 at about a fifth of the cost.

items.headline: Anthropic IPO prices today; reported demand could lift it above the $70-78 range
items.summary: Anthropic is set to price its 825M-share offering Wednesday and list Thursday; reports cite demand that could push it above $80. A $26B private placement from seven tech suppliers runs alongside the deal.

items.headline: Agile Robots raises $500M Series F at $8.5B led by SoftBank; Nvidia participates
items.summary: The Munich physical-AI firm has now raised $2B in total and runs a German plant able to build up to 10,000 humanoids a year. It also acquired Krause Automation from thyssenkrupp.

items.headline: Update on Genesis AI: $500M Series A at $3.5B confirmed, co-led by Premji Invest and Khosla
items.summary: Earlier reports are now detailed: Nvidia and AMD Ventures joined, total funding reaches $605M, and its Eno robot is in 30-40 pilot units. An LG CNS partnership was announced.

items.headline: Baidu's AI Cloud nearly doubles; external Qianfan token use up over 1,100%
items.summary: AI Cloud revenue rose 94% and GPU cloud 191% y/y, with core AI now 53% of general business. Advertising, once the core, fell to 48% of that segment.

items.headline: Release trackers log Tencent Hy4 Flash and Liquid AI d1.2 / d1.2-ultra
items.summary: BenchLM lists new Tencent Hy4 Flash and two Liquid AI d1.2 variants alongside Qwen4 Max for Nov 16. Pricing and benchmark details were not given.

items.headline: Reminder: Gemini 4 Carbon's $2/$10 intro pricing doubles to $4/$20 on Dec 1
items.summary: Developers weighing migrations face a price step-up in under two weeks. Carbon trails Claude Fable 5.2 on the Artificial Analysis index (60 vs 62) but leads on Terminal-Bench 4.0, per the report.

items.headline: Trending: t3code, Cloudflare's security-audit skill and agent 'skills' repos lead stars
items.summary: Weekly trending data show pingdotgg/t3code (+12k stars) and cloudflare/security-audit-skill (+11k) on top, with mattpocock/skills, anthropics/skills and claude-mem also climbing. Agent skills and memory remain the main open-source theme.

items.headline: Malaysia probes AI-run election influence operation disclosed by Anthropic
items.summary: Regulator MCMC requested details on the operation, which reportedly used ~1,000 fake X accounts and a fake news outlet. The case feeds into Malaysia's draft AI regulation bill.
